image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a cooked Dungeness crab served on a white plate. The crab's carapace is reddish-orange with some darker mottling. Several legs and claws are visible, appearing disjointed or broken, typical of a prepared meal. A metal seafood fork or cracker tool rests in the foreground. The lighting is warm and slightly glossy, highlighting the texture of the shell.
